name: Granted You'll Take It
source: You're a new uni student just trying to make it through the school year. One day, you start receiving letters signed by the same pen name, rumors start to spread that one of the popular students like you and your best friend starts acting more spontaneous.
translation: 你是一名大一新生，原本只想平平安安地熬过这一学年。然而某一天，你开始接连收到署着同一个笔名的来信；与此同时，校园里开始流传起某位风云人物喜欢你的传闻，就连你的挚友也变得比往常更加随性冲动起来。
